name: claude-code-action
one_liner: A GitHub bot you install that lets Claude answer questions and make code changes directly inside your pull requests and issues, triggered by a comment.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small-to-mid dev team who wants AI code review and fixes wired directly into their existing GitHub workflow without building it themselves.
business_use_cases: A dev agency installs it across client repos so clients can @-mention Claude in a PR to get quick fixes without waiting on a human developer.
An open-source maintainer uses it to auto-triage issues and draft first-pass fixes for simple bug reports, cutting maintainer burden.
A consulting shop offers 'set up AI-assisted code review for your GitHub org' as a fixed-price onboarding package for startups.

money_ideas.idea: Paid setup and configuration service tailoring the action's prompts and permissions to a client's specific repo and workflow.
A managed 'AI dev ops' retainer where an agency monitors and tunes the bot's behavior across a client's repos monthly.

steal_this: Install it on one client or open-source repo this weekend, configure two or three useful trigger commands, and offer it as a $300 'AI code review setup' package to a small dev shop.
